gotchas: Guest checkout works. The results deep link is /booking/flights?from=JFK&to=BOS&depart=YYYY-MM-DD&isMultiCity=false&noOfRoute=1&adults=1&children=0&infants=0&sharedMarket=false&roundTripFaresFlag=false&usePoints=false.

A TrustArc cookie dialog covers the page (div.truste_overlay intercepts clicks). It is in the top document; its accessible button name is 'Accept All Cookies' (capital C), although it reads 'Accept all cookies'.

Click the 'Main Standard seat $..' fare card to expand it, then 'Select' under Main Base or Main; a 'Main Flex' upsell modal follows: click 'Select Main'. Then Shopping Cart -> 'Continue to checkout' -> 'Continue as guest'.

Traveler Details asks for name, email, gender, date of birth, address and phone. Gender, Month, Day, Year and State are custom button pickers (click role=button[name="Gender"], then the role=option). Month options are short names (Jan, Feb). Address line 1 is an autocomplete combobox. The traveler address becomes the billing address on the payment step (Billing address 'Edit' button reopens it).
Seats & Extras: click 'Next: Review & Pay' to skip seats and extras.

Payment: card number and security code are TokenEx iframes (iframe[name="tx_iframe_tokenex-card-number-container"] and iframe[name="tx_iframe_cvv_tokenex-security-code-container"]), each with a visible input #data; use pressSequentially. Name on card and the mm/yy expiry are top-level inputs with autocomplete cc-name / cc-exp.
The trip-insurance radios (Yes/No) must be answered before paying; click role=radio[name=/^No, I choose not to protect/]. The final button is 'Accept & Pay'.
Billing fields carry no autocomplete attributes; they resolve by formcontrolname (city, stateCode, postalCode) and input[role=combobox] for line 1.
